name: Titanium.Blob
description:
A `Blob` represents a chunk of binary information, often obtained through
an [HTTPClient](api:Titanium.Network.HTTPClient) or by reading a [File](api:Titanium.Filesystem.File).

Blobs are often used to store text or image data.
The `Blob` object includes a number of properties and methods specific to image blobs.

Android supports an [append](api:Titanium.Blob#append) method, but
otherwise blobs are immutable.

The [Titanium.Utils](api:Titanium.Utils) module provides several utility methods for working with
blobs, including methods for converting between blobs and Base64-encoded strings,
and methods for generating SHA-1 and SHA-256 hashes and MD5 digests from blob data.

The [Buffer](api:Titanium.Buffer) object can also contain binary data, and is
more easily mutable. Extracting blob data to a buffer is somewhat roundabout:

``` js
var blobStream = Ti.Stream.createStream({ source: myBlob, mode: Ti.Stream.MODE_READ });
var newBuffer = Ti.createBuffer({ length: myBlob.length });
var bytes = blobStream.read(newBuffer);
```

Creating a blob from a buffer is much easier:
``` js
var newBlob = myBuffer.toBlob();
```

In both cases, the conversion involves copying the data from one object to another, so
you should be conscious of the amount of the data being copied.

properties.name: file
properties.summary:
File object represented by this blob, or `null` if this blob is not
associated with a file.

properties.name: height
properties.summary: If this blob represents an image, this is the height of the image in pixels.
properties.description:
If this blob doesn't represent an image, `height` is reported as 0.

**NOTE 1**: On SDK versions prior to 9.1.0, Ti.Blob images may have reported in points, not pixels.
This would occur for images with a higher density/scale returned by [Titanium.UI.View.toImage](api:Titanium.UI.View#toImage) or images with `@dx` density suffixes.
You may multiply by [Titanium.Platform.DisplayCaps.logicalDensityFactor](api:Titanium.Platform.DisplayCaps#logicalDensityFactor) to try and determine the pixels, but this value may be off for some pixel/density combinations.
(e.g. a `10px` image would report as `3` on a `3x` density screen, so multiplying would give you `9` pixels, which is still incorrect)

**NOTE 2**: This represents the height the platform decodes the image to in memory. iOS will automatically
rotate a JPEG based on its EXIF orientation when loaded into memory, but Android does not and instead
rotates it when shown on-screen. You can read the [uprightHeight](api:Titanium.Blob#uprightHeight) to determine
what the image height will be after rotation, if applicable.

properties.name: length
properties.summary: Length of this blob in bytes.

properties.name: mimeType
properties.summary: Mime type of the data in this blob.

properties.name: nativePath
properties.summary:
If this blob represents a [File](api:Titanium.Filesystem.File), this is the file URL
that represents it.
properties.description: If this blob doesn't represent a file, the value of `nativePath` is `null`.

properties.name: rotation
properties.summary: EXIF rotation of the image if available. Can be `undefined` if no orientation was found.

properties.name: size
properties.summary: Size of the blob in pixels (for image blobs) or bytes (for all other blobs).
properties.description:
If this blob represents an image, this is the total number of pixels in the image.
Otherwise it returns the number of bytes in the binary data.

properties.name: text
properties.summary: UTF-8 string representation of the data in this blob.
properties.description: If this blob represents pure binary data, the value will be `null`.

properties.name: uprightHeight
properties.summary: If the blob references an image, this provides the height in pixels after factoring in EXIF orientation.
properties.description:
The height of the image in pixels after rotating/flipping it based on its EXIF orientation,
which is commonly the case with JPEGs. Will return the save value as the [height](api:Titanium.Blob#height)
property if image does not have an EXIF orientation or if the orientation is already upright.

On iOS, properties [height](api:Titanium.Blob#height) and [uprightHeight](api:Titanium.Blob#uprightHeight) will always match.
On Android, these properties may differ when loading a JPEG since this platform does not automatically
rotate the loaded image in memory, but it is rotated when displaying it on-screen.

properties.name: uprightWidth
properties.summary: If the blob references an image, this provides the width in pixels after factoring in EXIF orientation.
properties.description:
The width of the image in pixels after rotating/flipping it based on its EXIF orientation,
which is commonly the case with JPEGs. Will return the save value as the [width](api:Titanium.Blob#width)
property if image does not have an EXIF orientation or if the orientation is already upright.

On iOS, properties [width](api:Titanium.Blob#width) and [uprightWidth](api:Titanium.Blob#uprightWidth) will always match.
On Android, these properties may differ when loading a JPEG since this platform does not automatically
rotate the loaded image in memory, but it is rotated when displaying it on-screen.

properties.name: width
properties.summary: If this blob represents an image, this is the width of the image in pixels.
properties.description:
If this blob doesn't represent an image, `width` is reported as 0.

**NOTE 1**: On SDK versions prior to 9.1.0, Ti.Blob images may have reported in points, not pixels.
This would occur for images with a higher density/scale returned by [Titanium.UI.View.toImage](api:Titanium.UI.View#toImage) or images with `@dx` density suffixes.
You may multiply by [Titanium.Platform.DisplayCaps.logicalDensityFactor](api:Titanium.Platform.DisplayCaps#logicalDensityFactor) to try and determine the pixels, but this value may be off for some pixel/density combinations.
(e.g. a `10px` image would report as `3` on a `3x` density screen, so multiplying would give you `9` pixels, which is still incorrect)

**NOTE 2**: This represents the width the platform decodes the image to in memory. iOS will automatically
rotate a JPEG based on its EXIF orientation when loaded into memory, but Android does not and instead
rotates it when shown on-screen. You can read the [uprightWidth](api:Titanium.Blob#uprightWidth) to determine
what the image width will be after rotation, if applicable.

methods.name: append
methods.summary: Appends the data from another blob to this blob.

parameters.name: blob
parameters.summary: Blob to append to this blob.

methods.name: arrayBuffer
methods.summary: Returns a `Promise` that resolves with the contents of the blob as binary data contained in an `ArrayBuffer`.

methods.name: imageAsCompressed
methods.summary: Creates a new blob by compressing the underlying image to the specified quality.
methods.description:
Returns the compressed image as a blob.

If this blob doesn't represent an image, returns `null`.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.summary: Quality to compress this image to. From 0.0 (lowest quality) to 1.0 (highest quality).

methods.name: imageAsCropped
methods.summary: Creates a new blob by cropping the underlying image to the specified dimensions.
methods.description:
Returns the cropped image as a blob.

If this blob doesn't represent an image, returns `null`.

parameters.name: options
parameters.summary:
Image cropping options. [Dimension](api:Dimension) properties are all optional for this use case.

Defaults will be to use the current image's `height`/`width` and to center the cropped rectangle horizontally/vertically on the original image (`x`/`y`).

methods.name: imageAsResized
methods.summary: Creates a new blob by resizing and scaling the underlying image to the specified dimensions.
methods.description:
Returns the resized image as a blob.

If this blob doesn't represent an image, returns `null`.

parameters.name: width
parameters.summary: Width to resize this image to.

parameters.name: height
parameters.summary: Height to resize this image to.

methods.name: imageAsThumbnail
methods.summary: Returns a thumbnail version of the underlying image, optionally with a border and rounded corners.
methods.description:
Returns the thumbnail image as a blob.

If this blob doesn't represent an image, returns `null`.

The final height/width of the image will actually be `size + (2 * borderSize)` as the border is added around the image.
By default the `borderSize` is `1`.

parameters.name: size
parameters.summary: Size of the thumbnail, in either width or height.

returns.summary: The image thumbnail in a blob.

methods.name: imageWithAlpha
methods.summary: Returns a copy of the underlying image with an added alpha channel.
methods.description: Returns the new image as a blob, or `null` if this blob is not an image.

returns.summary: The image with an alpha channel in a blob, or `null` if this blob is not an image.

methods.name: imageWithRoundedCorner
methods.summary: Returns a copy of the underlying image with rounded corners added.
methods.description:
Returns the new image as a blob, or `null` if this blob is not an image.
The image will grow in height and width by `(2 * borderSize)` as the border is added around the image to avoid scaling.
By default the `borderSize` is `1`.

parameters.name: cornerSize
parameters.summary: Size of the rounded corners in pixels.

parameters.name: borderSize
parameters.summary: Width of the border in pixels.

returns.summary: Image with a rounded corner in a blob, or `null` if this blob is not an image.

methods.name: imageWithTransparentBorder
methods.summary: Returns a copy of the underlying image with an added transparent border.
methods.description:
Returns the new image as a blob, or `null` if this blob is not an image.
The image will grow in height and width by `(2 * borderSize)` as the border is added around the image to avoid scaling.

parameters.name: size
parameters.summary: Width of the transparent border in pixels.

returns.summary: The image with a transparent border in a blob, or `null` if this blob is not an image.

methods.name: toArrayBuffer
methods.summary: Returns an `ArrayBuffer` representation of this blob.

methods.name: toString
methods.summary: Returns a string representation of this blob.
